site_number: LONDON MUSEUM OF WATER AND STEAM MUSEUM
description: Installation of fully mobile free standing interactive exhibit for Museum Use (continued use of previous permission)
site_name: London Museum Of Water And Steam
decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2.2, 3.2, 489- SVY-00 P1 and unnumbered photographs [received 2 January 2019], and Design and Access Statement, 489 WD 1402 (Rev.P) and Heritage Statement [received on 4 January 2019]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a temporary period of five (5) years from the grant of planning consent when the exhibit shall be removed in its entirety and the land restored to its former condition.
